description: Column layout of the Excel exports of Aplikasi Dapodik versi 2027: Daftar Guru, Daftar Tenaga Kependidikan, Daftar Peserta Didik (with the parent sub-columns), Rekap Pembelajaran, and the sections, numbered fields and tables of the PTK form (F-PTK). Headers and labels only: no personal data, no school data.
status: ready for these five exports; option codes wait for referensi-dapodik (R-07)
source: Exports of Aplikasi Dapodik versi 2027, semester 2026/2027 Ganjil (20261), downloaded by an SMP in Kabupaten Kudus on 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-20 and received from the user (2026-11-28); not kept (F-038): sizes and SHA-256 in sources/ekspor-dapodik/SOURCE.txt
licence: Structure of a government application's export (public government system); no content copied
procedure: python3 -I tools/converters/ekspor-dapodik.py <dir with the xlsx files> data/ekspor-dapodik, then tools/data-check --write. The converter refuses to write when any source value would appear in the output
